facts.value: The following documents are required for an application for the Master of Science in Business Administration.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: A Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or a related discipline is required.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: At least 90 ECTS in business-related modules must be obtained.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Solid knowledge of English at level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) is required.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Proof can be provided by one of the following: bachelor's degree entirely in English, standardized language test with B2 level, university English course with explicit B2 indication, or Abitur certificate showing English.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: The following proofs are not accepted: semester abroad, individual English modules in the bachelor's program, language courses at the university without explicit B2 level, CET-4 or CET-6.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Examples of acceptable language tests and minimum scores for B2 level: Cambridge Certificate (First Certificate in English A-C), DAAD Language Certificate B2, IELTS Academic (min. 5.0), LCCI (EFB Level 3), TOEFL (min. 72), TOEIC (min. 785), UNIcert (UNIcert II).
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Submit a current CV outlining the main stages of your education and professional experiences.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: A simple copy of the higher education entrance qualification (e.g., Abitur certificate) is required.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: International applicants must provide proof that they have passed the DSH-2 exam by the application deadline.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Applicants with certain qualifications (TestDaF, Goethe Certificate C2, KMK exam, other DSH certificates with minimum DSH-2 level) can be exempted from the DSH-2 exam.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Candidates with German knowledge at levels B1/B2/C1 may apply for a preparatory course for the DSH-2 exam during the application process.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Further information about the DSH exam and preparatory course can be found here: https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/43662503/dsh.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Applicants who completed their bachelor's degree in Vietnam, the People's Republic of China, or India need an APS certificate from the Academic Examination Office.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration

facts.value: Further information about the APS certificate can be found here: https://www.uni-frankfurt.de/134456293/APS_Zertifikat_der_Akademischen_Pr%C3%BCfstelle.
facts.programme_association: Master of Science in Business Administration
